gap.heading: Awaiting a backend endpoint
gap.noFake: No placeholder or fabricated data is shown. This module activates automatically once the endpoint ships.
gap.guestsBody: There is no first-class guest resource. Guest records exist only inside the reservation domain, with no list, search, profile or history endpoint.
gap.digitalAccessBody: Per-reservation check-in and access control work inside a reservation's workspace. A standalone desk view needs arrivals / departures / in-house list endpoints.
gap.paymentsBody: Payment state is visible per reservation (folio, checkout). A payments section needs a hotel- or group-scoped payments ledger.
gap.invoicesBody: An issued invoice is viewable inside its reservation's workspace. An invoices section needs a hotel- or group-scoped invoice ledger.
gap.settlementsBody: Final settlement runs inside checkout. A settlements section needs a settlement ledger endpoint.
gap.loyaltyBody: Loyalty balances and ledgers are reservation-scoped (guest identity is resolved server-side). A group loyalty dashboard needs a guest-scoped loyalty endpoint. The loyalty rule itself is configurable in the Hotel group section.
gap.reviewsBody: There is no reviews domain on the backend — no model, routes or controller for staff-side review management or moderation.
gap.notificationsBody: The notification feed is reservation-scoped and shown inside a reservation's workspace. A staff-wide operational feed needs a dedicated endpoint.
gap.reportsBody: There are no reporting endpoints (occupancy, revenue, hotel comparison, payments, checkout, services, loyalty).
gap.auditBody: Every sensitive action is written to the audit log, but there is no read endpoint to list or filter those records.
gap.folioBody: The folio is authoritative per reservation and read via its workspace. A standalone folio ledger needs a hotel- or group-scoped endpoint.
gap.checkoutBody: Checkout runs per reservation from its workspace. A checkout desk needs a departures / checkout-queue endpoint.
